fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: Drives the hook between the plates for 30 damage that ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scrape the Ranks
fusions.desc: Drags the edge across every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hooked Pauldrons
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Scrap Tithe
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
